architectureBlueprint:
## Modernization Blueprint: acme-theme

### 1. Theme client extension
- Written by the migrator: `client-extensions/acme-theme` (theme CSS, 1 Style Book token, logo, favicon, sticky.js).

### 2. Fragments (collection `acme-theme-fragments`)
- `acme-theme-header`: the `<header class="acme-header" id="banner">` of portal_normal.ftl.
  - Editable logo image and link, editable site name.
  - Search area shown when the configuration field `showHeaderSearch` (from the setting `show-header-search`) is on, with a drop zone for the Search Bar widget.
  - Drop zone for the Menu Display widget (replaces navigation.ftl).
  - `enableStickyHeader` (setting `enable-sticky-header`) toggles the `acme-sticky` class on scroll.
- `acme-theme-footer`: the `<footer class="acme-footer">` with an editable text.

### 3. Master page
- Header fragment, page drop zone, footer fragment; theme CSS `Acme Theme CSS`.

### API CONTRACT
- No Liferay Objects.

generatedFiles:
--- fragments/acme-theme-fragments/acme-theme-header/index.js ---
if (configuration.enableStickyHeader) {
	window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
		document.body.classList.toggle('acme-sticky', window.scrollY > 80);
	});
}
--- client-extensions/acme-theme/src/css/_custom.scss ---
@import 'components/breadcrumb';
@import 'acme/index';

body {
	header {
		background-color: $acme-header-bg;
	}
}

// Imported by the legacy theme's main.scss, which the design pack replaces
@import 'acme/sticky';

--- fragments/acme-theme-fragments/acme-theme-header/index.html ---
<header class="acme-header" id="banner">
	<a class="logo" data-lfr-editable-id="home-link" data-lfr-editable-type="link" href="/">
		<img alt="Logo" data-lfr-editable-id="logo" data-lfr-editable-type="image" src="" />
	</a>
	<span class="site-name" data-lfr-editable-id="site-name" data-lfr-editable-type="text">Acme</span>
	<div class="acme-search[#if !configuration.showHeaderSearch] d-none[/#if]">
		<lfr-drop-zone data-lfr-drop-zone-id="search-bar"></lfr-drop-zone>
	</div>
	<nav>
		<lfr-drop-zone data-lfr-drop-zone-id="navigation"></lfr-drop-zone>
	</nav>
</header>

--- client-extensions/acme-theme/client-extension.yaml ---
assemble:
    - from: assets
      into: static

acme-theme-css:
    clayURL: css/clay.css
    frontendTokenDefinitionJSON: src/frontend-token-definition.json
    mainURL: css/main.css
    name: Acme Theme CSS
    type: themeCSS

acme-theme-favicon:
    name: Acme Theme Favicon
    type: themeFavicon
    url: images/favicon.ico

acme-theme-sticky-js:
    name: Acme Theme sticky.js
    scriptLocation: bottom
    type: globalJS
    url: js/sticky.js
